correctness.rationale: For all n,i,j,t, conditioning on record i gives uniform first-i unordered sample and its maximal value at position i; symmetry of the nonmaximum values gives the negative earlier-position coefficient, while future values are independent of the internal prefix order. Summing exactly gives the local and total covariance identities; the inverse-binomial recurrence proves the strict sign threshold and monotonicity, and classical variance formulas give the asymptotic correlation. Exact arithmetic exhaustively verified 2524 checks including all permutations through order eight; finite checks are corroborative, not the infinite proof.

value.rationale: The two standard permutation statistics encode different aspects of rankings. A complete mixed threshold-by-position covariance kernel identifies a structural negative-before, positive-at, zero-after law and yields a nonobvious sharp crossover in total covariance at n=5. The fact that covariance converges to a positive constant while correlation decays to zero clarifies scale dependence; the problem is natural rather than an arbitrary parameter slice.
